purpose: Metadata-only immutable index of external IFC/IDS test pairs; no upstream test bytes are bundled.

license.distribution_policy: External inputs must remain unmodified and must not be copied into this repository or redistributed without rights review.

upstream.retrieval_policy: Checkout only the pinned commit for local/CI evaluation; verify every Git blob object ID and size before running any checker.

case_classification_policy: File names and directory labels do not establish expected pass/fail outcomes. Every case remains UNVERIFIED and NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL_CORPUS until an independently grounded oracle is recorded.
